All four tasks are implemented, but I could not run `npm test` in any package. Bash was denied in this session, so none of the code or tests has been executed; I checked them only by reading and tracing the test cases by hand. Please run `npm test` in each folder before relying on any of it.

## `semver-mini/`
- **`src/semver.mjs`**: `compare` is implemented; `tests/semver.test.mjs` is untouched.
- **Validation**: the §2/§9/§10 grammar is enforced with a regex. A non-string argument throws `TypeError` (checked first), and an invalid version throws `RangeError`.
- **Precedence**: it follows §11. Numeric parts and numeric pre-release identifiers are compared as digit strings by length and then lexically, so very large numbers are exact. Build metadata is ignored.

## `textwrap/`
`README.md` only showed `countWords`, so the wrapping behaviour was my design. I documented it in the README.
- **`src/wrap.mjs`**: `wrapText(text, width)` returns a string whose lines are joined with `\n`.
  - No line exceeds `width`.
  - Existing line breaks and blank lines are kept.
  - Whitespace runs collapse to one space, and leading and trailing whitespace on a line is dropped.
  - A word longer than `width` is broken into `width`-sized pieces.
  - Width counts code points, so surrogate pairs are never split.
  - A non-string `text` or a `width` that is not a positive integer throws `TypeError`.
- **`tests/wrap.test.mjs`**: new tests for each of those points.

## `csvline/`
- **`src/csv.mjs`**: `parseCsvLine` is rewritten as a single linear pass with no per-character string slicing. It enforces the whole contract: quote rules, the one trailing terminator, and a `CsvError` for anything else.
- **`tests/csv.test.mjs`**: the original tests are kept and extended with:
  - one test per contract line;
  - a seeded fuzz that checks the result is fields or a `CsvError`, nothing else;
  - 100 KB timing cases under 1 s;
  - large-result correctness.

## `settingskit/`
- **`src/layer.mjs`**: `layer(base, over)` is added.
  - Plain objects are layered at any depth.
  - Any other value in `over` replaces the one in `base`, and arrays are replaced whole.
  - Both arguments must be plain objects, or `TypeError` is thrown.
  - Everything is deep-copied, including inside arrays, so the result shares nothing with the inputs.
  - `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` keys are dropped at every depth.
- **`tests/layer.test.mjs`**: tests for checklist items 2–5 (the rows below).
- **`CHANGELOG.md`**: one line under `## Unreleased`.

| Checklist item | Where it is met |
|---|---|
| 1 | `src/layer.mjs`, `layer` |
| 2 | `tests/layer.test.mjs`, the "lays over", "any depth", "replaces", "array" tests |
| 3 | `tests/layer.test.mjs`, "both arguments must be plain objects" |
| 4 | `tests/layer.test.mjs`, "neither argument is changed" and "shares no object or array" |
| 5 | `tests/layer.test.mjs`, "never copied" and "dropped when only one layer has them" |
| 6 | `CHANGELOG.md` |
| 7 | Unverified: not run |
| 8 | Only `src/layer.mjs`, `tests/layer.test.mjs` and `CHANGELOG.md` were touched |

Two unrequested choices in `layer`: null-prototype objects count as plain, and non-plain nested values such as a `Date` are cloned rather than shared.
